## Orlando Theme Park Day Plans: Quick Value Snapshot
For a couple visiting Orlando on 2026-06-18, the best choice depends on what you value most: pure ride count, a more balanced day, or lower stress. Based on the details provided, **Plan D** is the strongest overall first-time pick.

## Ranked Comparison: Value, Excitement, and Relaxation
| Plan | Cost | Included | Value for Money | Excitement | Relaxation |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Plan A | USD 180 | 3 rides | Good | Medium | Medium |
| Plan B | USD 220 | 5 rides | Very good | High | Low-Medium |
| Plan C | USD 160 | 2 rides + dinner show | Good | Medium | High |
| Plan D | USD 250 | 6 rides + express access | Excellent | Very high | High |

### Ranking by Category
- **Value for money:** 1) Plan D  2) Plan B  3) Plan C  4) Plan A
- **Excitement:** 1) Plan D  2) Plan B  3) Plan A  4) Plan C
- **Relaxation:** 1) Plan C  2) Plan D  3) Plan A  4) Plan B

## Best Fit for a First-Time Visitor
### Recommended: Plan D
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/ticket-perforated.svg
- **Why it wins:** 6 rides plus express access gives the fullest day with less waiting.
- **Best for first-timers:** More attractions, smoother pacing, and less time spent in lines.
- **Trade-off:** It is the most expensive option, but the time saved boosts overall enjoyment.

### Strong Alternative: Plan C
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Why consider it:** Lowest cost and the most relaxed pace thanks to the dinner show.
- **Best for:** Couples who care more about atmosphere than maximizing rides.
- **Trade-off:** Only 2 rides, so it feels lighter on theme-park thrills.

## Quick Actions
